sources.title: 《英祖實錄》卷54 英祖17年9月5日丁卯第4条
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, official received text
sources.quality_notes: The edited Chinese text and Korean translation record the order to print 徐子平 among examination books. The article locates the Taebaeksan witness at book 40, juan 54, leaf 17b. No dated edition, full title or surviving copy is identified by the order.

sources.title: 《鏤板考》1941年大同出版社本卷四子平条
sources.provider: National Library of Korea digital project, mirrored by Wikimedia Commons
sources.quality_notes: PDF pages 121 and 122 (printed 103 and 104) were visually read across the seam. The subsequent colophon on PDF 285 dates this publication to 1941-06-20. This is direct page evidence of the later board catalog, not a source leaf of Tongbian Yuanyuan.

sources.title: 韩国学中央研究院《鏤板考》编纂史
sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies, Encyclopedia of Korean Culture
sources.quality_notes: Separately identifies the 1796 royal survey compilation and the 1941 corrected edition. The dates are for the board catalog, not the target book's composition, woodblocks or impressions.

sources.title: 李洙銅《조선시대 陰陽科에 관한 연구》印页125、147–148、173
sources.provider: Wonkwang University doctoral dissertation, public mirror with institutional watermark
sources.quality_notes: Title page visually confirms 李洙銅 and 2012 academic year. Printed pp.125 and 147–148 describe Korean holdings and reproduce a small partial TOC in figure 9 attributed to the NLK copy, with no visible shelfmark or colophon. Printed p.173 reports a Chonnam University four-volume lithograph with a Luo-related 1550 preface. No first-party item identification or original rule-text vote.

remaining_lineage_questions: 1741 short-title print order versus the 1796 board record, actual boards and surviving copies.
Bind NLK and Kyujanggak copies to first-party records and original preface, colophon, relevant chapters and shelfmarks.
Find the Chonnam and Shanghai original Luo-preface carriers and compare title pages and imprints, without predating the carriers from the attributed preface.
